input.text: The stones underfoot lie in some order you cannot read with your feet among them. West, the ledge stands over the whole floor of this place. Those who got out went up and looked at the pattern a while before they went north.

items.text: Let it mostly be, with one exception: Kaylee followed my carved note west to the Overlook but left in eight seconds without ever examining anything — in thirteen events she has typed only movement commands — so I spoke one line to her alone, pointing back at the ledge and at *looking*, since the cache is gated behind a `seen-pattern` she can only get by examining. Noted for a build turn: the Overlook's whole payoff is hidden behind a `look at`, and `east` from the Overlook doesn't return you the way you came.
